open_points.subject: REGISTRY_BASE_URL configuration lifecycle
open_points.text: A30 now says “REGISTRY_BASE_URL is read by the Registry gateway at each call, not at start-up,” while its unchanged carried change says the closed environment-variable table is “read into RuntimeSettings”; R0-10 likewise says environment configuration is validated when the service starts.
open_points.question: Is REGISTRY_BASE_URL a live environment value read for every Registry call, or a start-up value captured and validated in RuntimeSettings, and does the new sentence explicitly override the older start-up rules for this variable?
options: Read REGISTRY_BASE_URL from the environment on every Registry call; do not capture or validate it at start-up.
Read and validate REGISTRY_BASE_URL into RuntimeSettings at start-up; Registry calls use that captured value.
Capture any start-up value but re-read or replace it at each call, with an explicit precedence rule.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the newer, variable-specific rule as an exception: read REGISTRY_BASE_URL on every Registry call and do not store its value in RuntimeSettings.

witness.initial: The service starts while REGISTRY_BASE_URL denotes Registry endpoint A; its start-up RuntimeSettings have been constructed.
events: The deployment environment's REGISTRY_BASE_URL value is changed to endpoint B while the process remains alive.
A staff member performs a project-scoped operation that requires Registry validation.
outcomes: An implementation following the new A30 sentence reads the environment during the call and contacts endpoint B.
An implementation following R0-10 and config.runtime_environment_variables uses the start-up RuntimeSettings value and contacts endpoint A.
witness.observer: The staff caller and deployment operator see which Registry endpoint answers and potentially receive different authorization or failure results.
